facts.fact: Malawi and China Eximbank signed an RMB 693 million loan on 18 August 2020 for Phase II of the National Fibre Backbone Project (nearly 3,000 km of fibre), Huawei is the contractor, and President Chakwera launched Phase II on 29 June 2021; RMB 299.3 million had been disbursed by June 2023.

facts.fact: Malawi and China Eximbank signed an RMB 155.4 million loan for Phase I of the National Fibre Backbone Project (1,220 km on ESCOM transmission towers from Chitipa to Nsanje via Lilongwe, Blantyre and Zomba, connecting 24 of 28 districts); the deal record gives a 2017 start and a 2018 end, and the loan was ratified on 6 December 2016. The text does not say the fibre is lit.

facts.fact: ESCOM's optic fibre business states its national fibre backbone network is 7000 km, built on its electricity poles, with transport and MPLS backbone running in two rings centred on Lilongwe and Blantyre and linking Mzuzu, Kasungu, Salima, Zomba and Mangochi.
ESCOM states its national fibre backbone covers all districts of Malawi including Likoma Island (coverage extended through investment in 2017 and 2021).
